description: The Perfect Soft Chewy Cinnamon Sugar Cookies Soft, buttery, cinnamon-sugar perfection 🍪✨ Fresh out of the oven and impossible to resist. This Batch of cookie dough will make you anywhere between 12 to 15 cookies depending on the size you make.  —Ingredients— 1 and ¼ cups granulated sugar 1 large egg, room temperature 2 sticks unsalted butter, room temperature 1 teaspoon baking powder ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon salt 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 2 and ½ cups all-purpose flour —For Rolling— ¼ cup granulated sugar ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon   1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line baking sheets with parchment paper. 2. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, cream the butter and sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy. 3. Add the egg, vanilla extract, baking soda, baking powder, salt, and flour all at once. Mix on low-medium speed just until combined and a soft dough forms. Do not overmix. 4. In a small bowl, mix the ¼ cup sugar and cinnamon. 5. Scoop or roll dough into 1½-inch balls, then roll each ball in the cinnamon-sugar mixture. 6. Place dough balls on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2-3 inches apart. 7. Bake for 10–12 minutes, or until edges are set and lightly golden. I baked mine for 10 minutes.  8. Let cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely and enjoy!  #cookies #sugarcookies #easyrecipe #homemade #fromscratch
